companyDescription: Cell therapy · Deramiocel for Duchenne muscular dystrophy — thesis materially RECOVERED (not broken) since the Aug 13 report: FDA extended the PDUFA to Nov 22, 2026 for a BLA narrowed to the upper-limb-function endpoint the adcomm was directionally supportive on
priceNote: Live $5.83 (-1.7%) on Oct 26, 2026 — 52-week range $2.96-$40.37, -32% since Sep 29. Market cap ~$339M.
summary: REFRESH (prior report Sep 29, 2026). Q3 earnings (Nov 5) come first, then the deramiocel PDUFA (Nov 22) on the refined upper-limb DMD indication. The stock lost ~32% since Sep 29 as securities suits piled up; offsets are new HOPE-3 open-label data (76% slowing of upper-limb decline after crossover) and a B. Riley upgrade to Buy ($21). Consensus $27 (+363%; clears the gate). fda_decision is n=3 in core feedback (context only). Written against the core Base optimism bias of +23.7pp (realized 14d P75 +6.6%, P90 +11.7%). Base +40% assumes approval on Nov 22 and a ~1-2 month re-rating; the PDUFA is 27 days out, outside the 14d North Star window. แนะนำ 2-3% ของ portfolio — Speculative.

catalysts.name: Deramiocel PDUFA Decision — Upper-Limb Function Indication
catalysts.description: FDA target action date for the amended BLA, narrowed to upper-limb function (PUL 2.0 primary endpoint) after the Jul 29-30, 2026 adcomm voted 9-3 against the original DMD-cardiomyopathy claim but gave directionally supportive feedback on this narrower endpoint. Extended from Aug 22 to Nov 22, 2026 on Aug 24, 2026.

Securities class actions over the early-September disclosures.
A second CRL (after Jul 2025's -33% day) would likely force a dilutive raise.
The narrowed indication caps peak sales.
Launch execution for a novel cell therapy.

entryStrategy.verdict: SPECULATIVE — a two-sided Nov 22 PDUFA, 32% cheaper than at the last report. The measured core median at-catalyst return is -6.9% with 74% of picks underwater at their event (n=54), so Entry 2 ($5.00-5.40) is preferred and Entry 1 is a starter only.

catalystSpot.preRunup: Reverse run-up: CAPR fell ~32% since Sep 29 ($8.62 → $5.83) amid securities suits over early-September disclosures.

postWin.note: CAPR's own Dec 2025 Phase 3 HOPE-3 readout is the most direct precedent (+300% in 2 trading days on positive DMD data), but a November approval of an already-partly-priced-in narrowed claim would likely produce a smaller pop than a surprise data win. SRPT's narrow-label DMD approval (Jun 2023) is a cautionary comp — even an approval can disappoint if the label is restrictive.

postLose.note: CAPR's own Jul 30, 2026 reaction to the adcomm's 9-3 vote is the direct precedent (-36% in one day). A second rejection/CRL on the narrowed upper-limb indication in November would likely be at least as severe, possibly worse given it would be the drug's second regulatory setback on the same program.

spotSizing.reason: 3%. fda_decision has n=3 in core feedback (context only). The 9-3 adcomm vote against efficacy (original indication) makes this a genuinely two-sided binary.

stopPreCatalyst.note: Wider than the core overall medianMAE (-14%).

stopPostCatalyst.note: If FDA issues a second CRL, exit on day 1.

comparableCases.note: The event this refresh corrects for — a genuine, gradual recovery from the post-adcomm low, not a single-day pop. Same drug, same company, direct precedent for how the market re-prices a partially-derisked binary outcome.

comparableCases.event: FDA advisory committee votes 9-3 against DMD-cardiomyopathy effectiveness
comparableCases.note: The event that originally broke the thesis. Direct precedent for the downside if the Nov 22 PDUFA disappoints again.

comparableCases.event: Elevidys FDA accelerated approval (first DMD gene therapy) — restrictive label triggers a same-day drop despite the approval itself
comparableCases.note: A reminder that a narrow-label 'win' can still disappoint the market — CAPR's own narrowed upper-limb-only ask carries similar risk even in an approval scenario.
